rule_outs: Dwelling 3 m from the best section
summary: Swann Road kerb with homes 3-11 m away along nearly all of it.
reasons: Bus zone at the far end

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 3-4 m from the south kerb at 29-50 m, 8 m at 7 m, 10 m at 20 m, 11 m at 78 m; apartments 30 m at the end.
drivers.access_and_room: South kerb borders narrow garden verges; a few cars stand at the lane edge but there is no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-lane Swann Road with traffic both ways and a bus stop.
drivers.convention: Bus Zone sign 0.8 m from the kerb line near the end; a few cars park on the street but no clear parking lane.

flags: Bus Zone sign on the stretch
sun_shade: Dense tree cover shades the south side from 50 m on; the start is open.
